label: Draft written by the engineering assistant on the owner's instruction (decision E81), not by a clinician. Not approved. These texts are shown to nobody until the owner approves them and a release is served.

texts.shown_when: The service has understood something from the person's own words and it has not yet been confirmed. The assessment goes no further until the person has checked it.
texts.text: Before we continue, please check what we understood from your description. Confirm each detail that is right and correct anything that is wrong.
texts.why: The handoff requires that what is understood from free text is confirmed by the person before it is used. The text asks for exactly that and says nothing about health.

texts.shown_when: The assessment has found one or more possible explanations and shows them. This text stands above them as the next step.
texts.text: These are possible explanations for what you described. They are not a diagnosis. Please show this summary to a doctor, who can examine you and decide what it is. If your symptoms get worse or new symptoms appear, do not wait to see a doctor. In an emergency call 112 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
texts.why: The handoff allows provisional possible explanations only, never a diagnosis, and wants the next step shown first. The text names no illness, medicine or number, sends the person to a doctor, and says what to do if things get worse.

texts.shown_when: The assessment has finished and no possible explanation can be given from reviewed information.
texts.text: We do not have enough reviewed information to suggest a possible explanation for what you described. This does not mean that nothing is wrong. If you are worried, or your symptoms continue or get worse, please see a doctor. In an emergency call 112 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department. You can also add more details and try again.
texts.why: Finding nothing must not read as reassurance: the text says so in its second sentence. It gives a way forward (a doctor, or more details) and the emergency route.

texts.shown_when: A technical problem keeps the assessment from being completed. The person sees this instead of a result.
texts.text: We could not complete this assessment because of a technical problem. Nothing has been concluded about your symptoms. Please try again in a little while. If you need help now, please see a doctor. In an emergency call 112 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
texts.why: A failure must not look like a result. The text says that nothing was concluded, and does not leave a person who needs help with only an error.

open_points: The owner's approval of each text. Nothing here is used before it.
No doctor has read the texts. They give no medical advice beyond seeing a doctor and the emergency number, but a review is still advised with the rules.
The texts are in English only, as the product's first scope is.
Where the approved texts are stored and how the approval is recorded is built with the serving bundle (M2.5f).
